f.title: Notify SÚKL of PSMF changes when the PSMF is located in the Czech Republic
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders whose pharmacovigilance system master file is located in the Czech Republic must inform SÚKL of the following PSMF changes: change of QPPV; change of QPPV contact details (e-mail, telephone, postal address); change of PSMF location; change of MAH name; new pharmacovigilance database (replacement of the whole system including data migration); change of the PV database involving migration of data from another entity into the MAH's database (not routine updates or outward migration); new contractual or licensing partner performing PV activities relevant to products authorised in the Czech Republic; new patient programme or registry; and completed internal or external PV system audits with critical or major findings.
f.clause: 2. Changes to the Pharmacovigilance System Master File which need to be reported to SÚKL
f.applicability: MAHs whose PSMF is located in the Czech Republic

rows.quote: Pursuant to Sec. 91(2)(b) of the Act on Pharmaceuticals, marketing authorization holders are obliged to inform SÚKL about a change in the Pharmacovigilance System Master File, if this master file document is located in the territory of the Czech Republic.
rows.location: 2. Changes to the Pharmacovigilance System Master File which need to be reported to SÚKL
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: quote is the duty; the list of reportable changes was read in the text and summarised in the statement. Double-check: list items not inside the quote, kept below 90.

f.title: Report PSMF changes to SÚKL by e-mail with change type and MAH name in the subject
f.statement: MAHs inform the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department by e-mail. The subject must state the type of change (PSMF change) and the MAH name. For shared PV systems only the first MAH on the PSMF front page is named in the subject; the other MAHs are listed in the body.
f.clause: 2. How to report requested PSMF changes to SÚKL

rows.quote: The subject of the e-mail shall include information on the type of change (PSMF change) and the name of the marketing authorization holder. For shared pharmacovigilance systems, only the first marketing authorization holder indicated on the front page of the PSMF shall be included in the subject of the e-mail, the other marketing authorization holders shall be listed in the body of the e-mail.
rows.location: 2. How to report requested PSMF changes to SÚKL
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: quote stops before the mailbox address (checker rule). Double-check: OK.

f.title: Notify SÚKL of PSMF changes within 7 calendar days of implementation
f.statement: MAHs must notify the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department within 7 calendar days following implementation of the PSMF change.
f.clause: 2. Deadline for reporting requested PSMF changes to SÚKL
f.applicability: MAHs whose PSMF is located in the Czech Republic

rows.deadline: Within 7 calendar days following implementation of the change

f.title: Provide the QPPV name, surname and contact details to SÚKL (all MAHs)
f.statement: Every MAH must provide SÚKL with the name, surname and contact details of its QPPV, regardless of where the PSMF is located.
f.clause: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance

rows.quote: Pursuant to Sec. 91a(2) of the Act on Pharmaceuticals, the marketing authorization holder shall provide the name, surname and contact details of the qualified person for pharmacovigilance to SÚKL. This obligation applies to all marketing authorization holders, regardless of the location of the PSMF.
rows.location: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Ensure the QPPV resides and operates in the EU, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein
f.statement: The QPPV must reside and operate in the EU, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein; GVP Module I defines the QPPV requirements.
f.clause: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance

rows.quote: QPPV shall reside and operate in the EU, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein.
rows.location: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Ensure the QPPV has PV knowledge and medical, pharmaceutical, epidemiology and biostatistics expertise
f.statement: To carry out their activities, QPPVs must have theoretical and practical knowledge for performing pharmacovigilance activities, and expertise in, or access to expertise in, medicine, pharmaceutical sciences, epidemiology and biostatistics.
f.clause: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance

rows.quote: In order to carry out their activities, QPPVs must have - Both theoretical and practical knowledge for the performance of pharmacovigilance activities, - Expertise and access to expertise in the fields of medicine, pharmaceutical sciences, epidemiology, and biostatistics,
rows.location: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Provide a documented medically trained assistant to a QPPV without medical education
f.statement: Where the QPPV has no medical education, the MAH must ensure the QPPV is assisted by a medically trained person, and this assistance must be duly documented.
f.clause: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance

rows.quote: where the QPPV does not have medical education, the marketing authorisation holder shall ensure that the QPPV is assisted by a medically trained person and this assistance shall be duly documented.
rows.location: 3. Requirements for the qualified person for pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Report QPPV appointment or change to SÚKL by e-mail with full QPPV contact data
f.statement: MAHs report QPPV appointment or change to the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department by e-mail. The subject states the type of change (QPPV change or appointment) and the MAH name (for shared PV systems, only the first MAH on the PSMF front page; others in the body). The body must include the QPPV name, e-mail address, telephone number and postal address.
f.clause: 3. How to report QPPV appointment/change to SÚKL

rows.quote: The contact information in the body of the e-mail must include name, e-mail address, telephone number, and postal address of the QPPV.
rows.location: 3. How to report QPPV appointment/change to SÚKL
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: subject-line rules read in the text (same wording as section 2). Double-check: OK.

f.title: Notify SÚKL within 7 calendar days of QPPV appointment, change or contact detail change
f.statement: MAHs must notify the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department within 7 calendar days following appointment or change of the QPPV or change of the QPPV's contact details.
f.clause: 3. Deadline for reporting QPPV appointment/change to SÚKL

rows.deadline: Within 7 calendar days following appointment/change of the QPPV or of their contact details
rows.quote: Marketing authorization holders shall notify the Pharmacovigilance Department of SÚKL within 7 calendar days following the appointment/change of the QPPV or change of their contact details.
rows.location: 3. Deadline for reporting QPPV appointment/change to SÚKL
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Appoint a contact person for pharmacovigilance issues in the Czech Republic and notify SÚKL (all MAHs)
f.statement: SÚKL requests all MAHs, regardless of PSMF location, to appoint a contact person for pharmacovigilance issues in the Czech Republic and to notify the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department.
f.clause: 4. Appointment/change of the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues in the Czech Republic
f.legal_basis: Act No. 378/2007 Coll. Sec. 91a(3); DIR Art 104(4)

rows.quote: the marketing authorisation holders to appoint a contact person for pharmacovigilance issues in the Czech Republic and to notify about this the Pharmacovigilance Department of SÚKL. This obligation applies to all marketing authorization holders, regardless of the location of the PSMF.
rows.location: 4. Appointment/change of the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues in the Czech Republic
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: SÚKL "requests" under Sec. 91a(3); the text calls it an obligation. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Ensure the Czech PV contact person speaks Czech or Slovak, has a Czech phone number and resides in the EU
f.statement: The contact person for pharmacovigilance issues must be able to communicate in Czech or Slovak, be reachable on a phone number with the Czech country code and reside in the EU.
f.clause: 4. Requirements for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues

rows.quote: The contact person for pharmacovigilance issues shall fulfil the following:  be able to communicate in Czech or Slovak language,  be contactable on a phone number with the Czech country code,  reside in the EU.
rows.location: 4. Requirements for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: The QPPV may also act as the Czech PV contact person
f.statement: The QPPV and the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues may be the same person.
f.clause: 4. Requirements for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues

rows.quote: The QPPV and the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues may be the same person.
rows.location: 4. Requirements for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Define the Czech PV contact person's responsibilities in the PSMF, at minimum liaison between SÚKL and the QPPV
f.statement: The contact person is part of the MAH's pharmacovigilance system and their responsibilities are set out in the PSMF. Their minimum responsibility is to provide the contact between SÚKL and the QPPV.
f.clause: 4. Requirements for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues

rows.quote: The contact person for pharmacovigilance issues is a part of the marketing authorization holder's pharmacovigilance system, whose responsibilities are set out and listed in the PSMF. The minimum responsibility of the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues is to provide the contact between SÚKL and the QPPV.
rows.location: 4. Requirements for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Report the Czech PV contact person appointment or change by e-mail with contact data and represented MAHs
f.statement: MAHs report the appointment or change of the contact person by e-mail to the SÚKL Pharmacovigilance Department. The subject states the type of change and the name of the represented MAH; where several MAHs are involved, all are listed in the body and one in the subject. The body must include the contact person's name, e-mail address and telephone number and the names of all represented MAHs.
f.clause: 4. How to report contact person for pharmacovigilance issues appointment/change to SÚKL

rows.quote: The contact information in the body of the e-mail must include name, e-mail address and telephone number of the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues and the name of the represented marketing authorization holder (all represented marketing authorization holders).
rows.location: 4. How to report contact person for pharmacovigilance issues appointment/change to SÚKL
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: subject-line rules read in text. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Optionally inform SÚKL of a deputy contact person by the same procedure
f.statement: The MAH may also inform SÚKL of the contact person's deputy, if one is appointed, using the same procedure.
f.clause: 4. How to report contact person for pharmacovigilance issues appointment/change to SÚKL

rows.quote: The marketing authorization holder may also inform SÚKL of the contact person's deputy if one is appointed. The procedure is the same as for the contact person for pharmacovigilance issues.
rows.location: 4. How to report contact person for pharmacovigilance issues appointment/change to SÚKL
rows.review_note: National (Czech Republic) SÚKL guideline, legally binding per its text; English version published by SÚKL; marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
